name: NASA Blue Marble Shaded Relief and Bathymetry — fine continuous global base
license: NASA Earth Observatory imagery; credit NASA / MODIS / GEBCO
epoch: Historical Blue Marble Next Generation composite (2004); not live imagery
processing: All 800 real level-5 JPEG tiles assembled in EPSG:4326 grid without recolouring, overlays, synthetic texture or AI upscaling. Lanczos downsample; JPEG quality 94, 4:4:4 chroma.
detailNote: Natural colour and shaded mountain/sea-floor relief. Resolution supports regional terrain and some major urban agglomerations; it is not street or building imagery.
